sources.license_observation: Article is CC BY; an independently downloadable raw trace license was not established.
sources.measurement_description: Water mass on RADWAG AS 60/220.R2 balance every 30 s for 5 min; three repeats at each of nine syringe-volume/motor-speed combinations. Paper analyzes averaged readings with water density assumed 1 g/mL.
reasons: Public article reports means/curves; individual source trace identities and machine-readable mass/time rows were not acquired.
Motor settings 1, 5 and 9 are not recorded volumetric target_flow_ul_min setpoints.
The paper density assumption is not a measured density for these conditions.

reasons: Files are restricted; no measurement file was acquired.

Individual trace identities, units and density provenance could not be inspected.

decision: No raw dataset acquired satisfies this repository measurement contract. No public-data fit or physical/biological validation was performed.
method: Inspect primary article/repository methods, data availability and publicly listed files; refuse figure means, synthetic/model outputs, unidentified biological replicates, restricted files and incompatible units/geometry. This is a bounded source audit, not proof that no suitable public dataset exists.
